name: Summarizer API
plain: Summarises long text on the device.
meaning: Produces key points, TL;DR, teaser or headline from text without sending it off the device.

access.prompt_ui: Download on first use; needs user activation
access.iframe: Same as top level; cross-origin iframes need a permissions policy where listed

data.metric: Summarises long text on the device.

fields.name: length
fields.precision: tldr and teaser 1 to 5 sentences; key-points 3 to 7 bullets; headline 12 to 22 words

limits.headline: Can summarize a long text on your device, without sending it away
limits.user_action: You tap a button like Summarize, TL;DR or Key points
can: Make key points, a TL;DR, a teaser or a headline from text
Run on your device after the model downloads once
Summarize page text or text you pasted
cannot: Start before a click or tap
Send your text to a server for this
Work in Firefox, Safari or on phones
Be sure to be accurate, since local models can miss details
limits.differs: Chrome and Edge on computers only.

story.what_it_is: A page can shorten long text into a summary using an AI model on your device.

marketing.name: Summarizer API
marketing.pitch: Lets sites summarize long text locally with Chrome's built in AI, with options for key points, tl;dr and more.

story.for_you: You tap Summarize on an article, review or document and get a short version. It runs on your device after a click. Your text stays on your computer.
story.for_makers: Makers add summaries with no server fees, which makes the feature cheap at scale. It keeps private text private. The model is small, so it may miss details.

use_cases.example: A news site shows a three point summary of a long article on tap.
A store summarizes hundreds of reviews into pros and cons.
A web mail app summarizes a long thread on device.
A study site summarizes a lecture transcript for review.
A video site summarizes a transcript so you can skip to the key part.
A company wiki summarizes long pages for staff without sending data out.
A game wiki or forum site condenses a long patch notes post into the key changes.
A page gives a short version for readers who find long text hard.

technical_bounds: Needs Gemini Nano hardware: Windows 10 or 11, macOS 13+, Linux, or ChromeOS Plus; 22 GB free disk; GPU over 4 GB VRAM or CPU with 16 GB RAM and 4 cores
